question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority across the Chinese Communist Party, state institutions, and Central Military Commission underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against removal before 2027. No successor has been designated, elite appointments and recent military leadership adjustments have reinforced rather than challenged his position, and scheduled leadership transitions remain aligned with the 2027 Party Congress rather than abrupt shifts. Public appearances and policy continuity through mid-2026 show no factional challenges or health signals capable of prompting elite realignment ahead of December 2026. While probabilities this elevated reflect the absence of credible near-term catalysts, realistic disruptions could still arise from an acute medical event, a severe economic downturn generating internal consensus for change, or an external crisis that fractures elite cohesion before year-end.
